body:
Maria: Quick runway check for tomorrow's microsummit — finalizing registration + Zoom/recording handoff. Can everyone confirm their pieces?
Jamal: Registration page updated with new CTA + UTM params. live link: https://redwood.ai/events/microsummit (GA tag applied). Added GDPR consent checkbox.
Olivia: Awesome. Zoom question — do we have cloud recording + local backup, and SRT/RTMP fallback?
Jamal: I turned on cloud recording (auto-record to cloud) and enabled alternative hosts: @Olivia. I also configured a meeting setting for streaming to custom RTMP as fallback.
zoom-bot: Meeting created: ID 987-654-321, start 2026-04-15T15:00:00Z. Cloud recording: enabled. Join link: https://zoom.us/j/987654321
Sam (AV Ops): AV checklist: greenroom 30m prior, OBS RTMP → CDN as mirror, local recorder on presenter laptop (1080p@30), and we’ll start a local recording on stage mac as backup. Captioning path: Otter.ai live SRT + save SRT to bucket.
Maria: Lead routing — new registrants should go to HubSpot list "MS-Apr-2026" and trigger zapier -> Segment -> add to SDR queue 'inbound-webinar'. Attendees get "attended" property for follow-up.
Jamal: Confirmed zap flow: Typeform -> HubSpot -> add tag 'microsummit-2026' -> webhook -> /api/lead/inbound. I added a filter to only send attendees after attendance ping.
Olivia: Post-event plan: 24h nurture email with highlights + survey link (Typeform). Clips + full transcript published to gated landing page. Who owns clip edits?
Kevin (Video): I’ll own clips. Deliverables: 1 hero 90s clip, 3 vertical shorts (30s), and 1 3-min product demo cut. ETA: EOD+2. I’ll convert SRT -> VTT for platform captions.
Sam (AV Ops): Backup note: if cloud recording corrupts, we have local recorder and RTMP mirror. Confirm presenters know to hit local record if asked. Also keep OBS rolling.
Olivia: Captions: Otter will push SRT to s3://redwood-marketing/microsummit/ — Kevin can pull from there.
Maria: Messaging tweak — switching hero line in the post-email from "High-throughput LLM inference" to "Serve LLM features with predictable latency and cost." Thoughts?
Jamal: Love the clarity. Maybe shorten to "predictable latency and cost" — fewer words in subject lines.
Kevin (Video): For the 24h email subject A/B test: A) "Thanks for joining — clips & next steps" B) "Microsummit recap + demo access" — I'll prepare thumbnails for both.
Maria: Add 1-slide summary PDF to follow-up assets and a TL;DR for folks who couldn't attend. Also include CTA to book a demo (Calendly link).
Olivia: Ops question — is the RTMP fallback bitrate set to 4Mbps? We need it at 3.5–4 for decent quality but still streamable.
Sam (AV Ops): RTMP fallback set to 4Mbps, keyframe 2s, audio 128kbps. OBS scene named "microsummit-rtmp" — I'll push settings to the runbook.
Maria: Survey question set: 3 quick MCQs + 1 open text. We’ll use responses to feed the nurture segmentation.
Jamal: I've added an attendee tag that triggers a follow-up workflow: attenders -> 24h email -> clip delivery -> demo CTA. No-show registrants go to a separate nurture with replay CTA.
Kevin (Video): Small edit workflow: pull SRT, convert to VTT, color grade, export H.264 and verticals. Upload to GDrive: Marketing/Events/Microsummit/edits.
Olivia: Who's copying transcript to Knowledge Base?
Maria: I'll drop the cleaned transcript into Notion and attach to the event page. Assigning: @Maria -> transcript -> Notion.
Sam (AV Ops): Quick commands for runbook (paste in greenroom):
```
OBS profile: Microsummit-RTMP
RTMP URL: rtmp://live.cdn.example/stream
Key: microsummit_2026_key
Start obs record: ctrl+alt+r
```
Jamal: Also set HubSpot field mapping: {email, first_name, company, utm_source, attended}. (Assigned in Zap config).
Maria: Final ask — please confirm readiness by EOD and paste any final Zoom/account screenshots here.
Jamal: Confirmed. GA events firing on registration form.
Olivia: Confirmed. Alt host and cloud recording checks done.
Kevin (Video): Confirmed. SRT ingest path tested.
Sam (AV Ops): Confirmed. OBS scenes tested, RTMP fallback validated.
Maria: Thanks team :thumbsup: Any last-minute blockers?
Olivia: None from my side. Greenroom invite sent to speakers.
deploy-bot: Recording snapshot scheduled and backup job queued to s3://redwood-marketing/microsummit/recordings/2026-04-15/
Maria: Perfect. We'll reconvene 30m before showtime in #greenroom.
